paras: Lygisaurus tanneri, also known commonly as the Endeavour River litter-skink and Tanner's four-fingered skink,  is a species of lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Australia.
The specific name, tanneri, is in honor of Australian herpetologist Charles Tanner (1911–1996).
L. tanneri is found in Queensland, Australia.
The preferred natural habitat of L. tanneri is forest.
